shared_elements: animal shown with distinct forelimbs/paws and clawed feet
single large animal occupying the main face of an upright pillar/slab
animal body rendered with articulated limbs and haunches
justification: Both surfaces depict a single large quadruped predator with clearly articulated limbs and paws dominating the face of an upright slab/pillar, which is a reasonably specific shared conception (a beast as the sole subject of a standing stone). They differ markedly in form and manner: A shows the animal flat, in horizontal profile, as a shallow linear outline relief, whereas B's animal is a near-sculptural high relief with a head carved in the round and the body oriented vertically, head downward, plus an additional carved motif above it.
